original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家应急管理局在洪水预警前开展搜救培训
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家应急管理局（NEMA）周三为工作人员组织搜救复训，以加强应对即将到来的洪水。尼日利亚水文服务局（NIHSA）此前预警称约15个州将出现严重山洪和河流洪水。NEMA局长已指示全部17个外地办事处提升洪水应对准备。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚国家应急管理局为工作人员组织搜救复训以应对即将到来的洪水
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) on Wednesday organised a refresher training on Search and Rescue for its staff as part of measures to heighten preparedness for impending floods.

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚水文服务局预警称约15个州将出现严重山洪和河流洪水
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the training followed an alert by the Nigeria Hydrological Services Agency (NIHSA) that about 15 states would experience heavy flash and riverine flooding.

key_facts.fact: NEMA局长指示全部17个外地办事处提升洪水应对准备
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General, Mrs Zubaida Umar directed all the 17 field offices to heighten their readiness in response to flood.

key_facts.fact: 培训以在阿布贾Jabi Dam进行的水上安全实操结束
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: would end with a practical session on marine safety at the Jabi Dam in Abuja.

uncertainties: 洪水预警的具体影响范围与时间尚未证实
目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
